summary: - **[key4hep/k4FWCore#459](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/459)** — OverlayTiming selects background SimCalorimeterHits relative to time of flight, like signal and tracker hits, and adds ApplyTimeOfFlight; calorimeter TimeWindows tuned for the old behaviour may need revisiting.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#157](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/157)** — Multi-pass CKF tracking for CLD runs five passes tuned on CLD_o2_v08, using new UnusedHitsAlg and SplitTrackRemovalAlg to recover soft and displaced tracks missed by single-pass seeding.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#151](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/151)** — The ACTS blueprint builds CLD and ILD_FCCee sensor surfaces on the sensitive silicon rather than the passive module, restoring CLD endcap hits that tracking had been dropping.
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#143](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/143)** — Adds material receivers and a CLD_o2_v08 material map
